_comment: Passages that must never be split or merged by segment-passages.mjs. Each entry becomes exactly one study unit. Widely recognised, frequently recited or frequently shared passages only — no sectarian selections.

Hearts find rest in the remembrance of God
If you are grateful, I will give you more
God commands justice and good conduct

The qualities of the successful believers
The counsel of Luqman to his son
The believing men and the believing women
God and His angels send blessings on the Prophet
Do not despair of God's mercy
Repel evil with what is better
